data.title: Go until you hit the wall
story: Each warehouse corridor has a different length. A fixed number in range() will not fit them all.
while front_clear(): keeps the robot moving as long as the way ahead is clear.
data.solution:
while front_clear():
    forward()
pick_up()
turn_right()
while front_clear():
    forward()
deliver()

explanation: while checks the sensor before every step, so the same program works in short and long corridors alike. That is sturdier than counting steps.
hints: There are three maps with different corridor lengths. A fixed count will fail on one of them.
After turning right, use while front_clear(): again to reach the flag.
